items.title: What is AIVIVE?
items.description: AIVIVE is an advanced AI image generation platform that allows you to create high-quality images from text descriptions and reference images.

items.title: Is it free to use?
items.description: We offer a free trial with limited credits. For more features and higher limits, you can upgrade to a paid plan.

items.title: Can I use the images commercially?
items.description: Yes, all images generated on paid plans come with a full commercial license.

items.title: How does the credit system work?
items.description: Each generation costs a certain number of credits depending on the settings and quality. Credits are renewed monthly.

items.title: Do you offer refunds?
items.description: Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee if you're not satisfied with our service.

items.title: Can I cancel my subscription?
items.description: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings.
